pr_body: Closes https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12371 --- This is the PR from https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20134 that "merges" the close button and the indicator icon (similar to vscode), and does some overall improvements to the editor tab, like: - not showing the indicator when autosave is enabled - a bit more horizontal spacing between the slots. - default file icons to true - add symlink icons *Mouse hovering over the close button* --- The start slot will also be used in a followup PR that adds git symbols, but it's been stalled with the introduction of diagnostic icons, and may require a redesign? cc @danilo-leal --- Release Notes: - Improved editor tabs. ([#20769](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20769))
pr_comments: @nervenes : In this case if the x is on the left, I think there is too much space on the right.

@Angelk90 if you're suggesting that the right side should have less spacing because it's empty, then the tab size will change whenever an empty slot gets populated or a populated slot gets emptied, and that's likely not what is wanted. otherwise, maybe the middle ground screenshot i uploaded above is better?

Keeping tabs visually balanced is really difficult and there are a lot of cases to consider. We'll need to find some designer time (either I or @danilo-leal) to review this and ensure we are happy with where this lands things.

> not showing the indicator when autosave is enabled

I don't think we would ever not want to show the dirty indicator. It is a clear indicator meant to help you understand the state of the buffer – a number of things happen when a buffer goes from clean -> dirty and dirty -> clean that we want to always be clear.

> default file icons to true

I don't think this should be a default. We are already fighting off an overall increase in visual noise in Zed, and horizontal real estate in the tab bar is at a premium. This is easy enough to turn on, and will be more clear as we add settings UI
okay, ill revert the icon and dirty indicator defaults then, but could i add settings for the latter for customizability?

Zed currently displays an icon in the project panel to identify symlinks. Closing as we intend to avoid adding additional visual clutter in the tab bar. Thanks for reporting.

review_comments: I think the spacing of the tab slots is fine as is. These changes make it look too large.
I think the way it was makes the items too clumped together, for references this is how it looks like: this is the pr: maybe a middle ground?
This density is a _feature_ of Zed, not something we are looking to avoid!

I think what you are rubbing up against is the right side spacing that is making things feel off. First or last here feel reasonable to me, but the right side spacing still feels unbalanced.

I'd also reduce the symlink icon size + make it `Color::Muted` to see if that helps

for the symlink icon, i'm considering to put it at the end of the file name instead of the start slot, similar to how the file icon is before the file name instead of a particular slot, and preserve the start slot entirely for git symbols. does that sound okay with you? that could also make the right side feel a bit more balanced. i'll see if i can whip something up soon and upload a screenshot for demonstration
